title: Combine promising benchmark motifs for parameter-golf

operationalConstraints: Use TASK_STORE_DIR as the authoritative task-store binding when selecting combination candidates.
Append one bounded combination experiment record to authoritative measurement evidence and refresh derived views.
Keep this spike scoped to evidentiary output without any benchmark-readiness promotion side effects.

boundaries: Task store selection is the single boundary for determining which combination candidate can run next.
Combination execution in this slice is bounded to one experiment append and view regeneration using existing evidence interfaces.
Readiness and promotion logic remain outside this FAST-24 slice to prevent hidden scope expansion.
interfaces: Input: task-store task payload with lane=combination, candidateId, runConfig, traceId, and budgetCaps.
Input/Output: authoritative evidence interface that appends one combination experiment record and updates summary fields.
Output: execution outcome payload carrying taskId, candidateId, reasonCode, status, and completedAt for operators.
risks: Missing lane isolation could allow non-combination work to consume the combination budget.
Weak evidence write guarantees could leave operator-visible views stale after a successful append.
Unbounded retries could exhaust compute budget without producing clearer motif-combination signal.
implementationReadyDecisions: Candidate seed for this spike is fixed to combination-promising-motifs.
Budget cap is fixed via maxExperimentsPerCombination=1 for this FAST-24 scope.
Outputs are evidentiary only and explicitly avoid benchmark-readiness claims.
